full_AB.text: I see . Let me show you some samples of various qualities . This one is very nice . It's three hundred and fifty dollars .

full_AB.speaker: A

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: We are having a sale now . The price has already gone down .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: How much is that one ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: It's two hundred and eighty dollars .

full_AB.text: OK . I'll take it . Thank you .

full_AB.speaker: B

full_AB.text: I'm sorry but I can't make the final decision myself , and I have to discuss it with other interviewers .

full_AB.text: Your mentality is very good and that's great .

full_AB.text: we really were lucky . We got the last available table for two---and we didn't even have a reservation ! Did you see the long lines behind us ?
